tasks.subject: School trip: your ideas?
tasks.text: …Thanks for your last message! Our class is organising a trip at the end of term, and our teacher says each of us should suggest a place. I'm thinking about the science museum, but I'm not sure. Which places are best for a school trip, in your opinion, and why? How often do you go on school trips? Would you rather go with classmates or with your family? By the way, I've just started learning the guitar…

answers: get to know each other better
questions: How long have you been learning?
Do you have lessons at school or privately?
What kind of music do you want to play?
